content: Lost Marbles (@lostmarbles2d, 150K+ subs, 400+ videos) is a YouTube channel of Unity-made simulated marble runs and battles. Formats include Marble Kingdoms (colored kingdoms battle on a map until one color survives), The Great Marble Weapon Battle, Multiply or Release, Marble Legions, and marble elimination races. Watchability levers: simple legible rules, clear color-team identity, suspense of elimination, escalating chaos, short self-contained episodes, and a persistent series format (numbered episodes) that builds audience. The Marble Kingdoms format is the direct inspiration for this project. Takeaway: legible team color + suspenseful elimination + series format drive watchability more than visual fidelity.
